format_only_group_normalization.interpretation: A varying .2 format term can produce near-unit standardized credit even when task accuracy is fixed. Tier C all-full-format/task-varies gate excludes this fixture; historical/unfiltered groups differ.

group_size_active_probability.assumption: IID binary task success, all full format, equal overlong; analytic illustration only
group_size_active_probability.interpretation: K changes mixed-success probability. Requiring every response full-format can make K8 LESS eligible than K4 under independent q=.8; uniform attempted categories can yield unequal active updates. Binary categorical label entropy is at most1bit, which does not bound the image reasoning difficulty. These are not observed MRI rates.
group_size_active_probability.strict_gate_assumption: Each response full-format independently with probability q=.8, independent of IID binary success p=.5; eligibility=q^K*[1-p^K-(1-p)^K].

image_derivative_does_not_prove_rl_signa.interpretation: A nonzero per-response/CE image derivative can cancel under signed group advantages. CE evidence cannot establish full visual GSPO credit.

ratio_one_loss_zero_gradient_nonzero.interpretation: Forward ratio=1 and mean advantage=0 do not imply zero gradient. Current logp derivative survives detach; clipping is inactive.

sequence_credit_dilution.interpretation: Holding only label-token sensitivity nonzero, adding invariant wrapper tokens dilutes label gradient by response length. This is expected seq-mean-token-mean behavior in both sources.

stale_minibatch_clipping_counterexample.interpretation: For favorable movement of 0.001 in mean logp, both examples clip and gradient=0; the matching on-policy fixture has gradient=-1.5. Scheduling can matter, but no local bug is established.

teacher_force_identity_blind_spot.interpretation: Equal prompt length plus recomputed old=current cannot detect different generation inputs. This is a synthetic counterexample to sufficiency of checks, not evidence actual generation inputs differ.

fix_decision: NO_FROZEN_SOURCE_EDIT: no native loss defect proved by these fixtures.
